question.text: How’s it going? How have you been?

answer.text: I’m doing well. How about you?
I’m from Brazil and I live in a city place between Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo.
Well … It was a typical day. I worked a lot, and I had some meetings, but one meeting was long. I got tired, but I felt good.

question.text: What do you do for a living?

answer.text: You know, I’ve been working as a software engineer for about 30 years. I’ve already worked for big and small companies in Brazil. The point is I really love my work because I get to create many solutions to solve a lot of problems, even though sometimes I get stressed. I also like trading stock options in the Brazilian stock market. Although I know I can lose some money, I strongly follow my trading plan and my risk management.

question.text: What did you do last weekend?

answer.text:
Well… on Saturday, I went to Minas Gerais by motorcycle with my friends. So, we had a wonderful day surrounded by waterfalls, wild animals, and nature. After that we had lunch in a good restaurant.

Let me think… on Sunday, I went with my wife to a restaurant; we had fried fish with vegetables, rice, and a lot of spices.

question.text: How long have you been using this App?

answer.text:
I guess I’ve been using this app for about 58 days. The point is that I liked HelloTalk so much that I signed up for a VIP subscription a few days ago. I think this app is awesome!

I believe coming here every day is part and parcel of my process.

You know what. First of all, my greatest motivation to be here is to improve my English speaking. Maybe I also want to work for any international software development company. I don’t know! And finally, I might make some friends here to practice English, even I might teach portuguese for them. I can't stand the idea that I won't be able to speak English.

question.text: How do you want to feel by the end of the year?

answer.text:
That’s a good question. I’ve never thought about this…. By the end of the year, I want to be speaking English with more confidence. This is my point. That's why I’m doing this challenge every single day in my spare time.

On the other hand, I also hope to finish a few things around the house, such as buying a new shelf for the kitchen and installing an air conditioner in my bedroom and the living room. Moreover, I want to install the new windows in my barbecue area.

For private things, I also want to keep riding motorcycles with my friends every 2 weeks whenever I can because I like going to the beach and visiting new places.

question.text: How would you describe yourself to someone who doesn't know you?

answer.text:
So that’s a good question. I’ve never thought about this. I’m an anxious guy. I’m usually a funny guy because I like to tell jokes to my friends.

I think I’m a good father and husband. I’m sometimes a little bit tough on him, but it’s necessary because I have to be a role model for him.

Most of the time I’m patient. I can be a little bit impulsive sometimes.

I like going to the beach as much as I can. I’m really into riding my motorcycle every weekend with my friends whenever I can.
